mapper.select: SELECT tr.*, reviewer.name AS reviewer_name, reviewer.avatar_url AS reviewer_avatar_url, reviewee.name AS reviewee_name, reviewee.avatar_url AS reviewee_avatar_url FROM task_reviews tr LEFT JOIN users reviewer ON tr.reviewer_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN users reviewee ON tr.reviewee_id = reviewee.id WHERE tr.id = #{id}

SELECT tr.*, reviewer.name AS reviewer_name, reviewer.avatar_url AS reviewer_avatar_url, reviewee.name AS reviewee_name, reviewee.avatar_url AS reviewee_avatar_url FROM task_reviews tr LEFT JOIN users reviewer ON tr.reviewer_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN users reviewee ON tr.reviewee_id = reviewee.id WHERE tr.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY tr.created_at ASC

SELECT tr.*, reviewer.name AS reviewer_name, reviewer.avatar_url AS reviewer_avatar_url, reviewee.name AS reviewee_name, reviewee.avatar_url AS reviewee_avatar_url FROM task_reviews tr LEFT JOIN users reviewer ON tr.reviewer_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN users reviewee ON tr.reviewee_id = reviewee.id WHERE tr.task_id = #{taskId} AND tr.reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_reviews (task_id, reviewer_id, reviewee_id, reviewer_role, rating, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{reviewerId}, #{revieweeId}, #{reviewerRole}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
